title: Page 2
transc:
Geo D. Sheldon  Jany 30th 1864
Pagan Jany Thirtieth Clara for Audit
on the absence of the Vernon
commanding I have the honor to
in form you that those men
of Parkers Shylock of Relay now
in Pagoda will leave this city
tomorrow morning by Steamer period They
will not number more than fifty
enlisted men There are said to
be some two hundred recruits for
the Stanhope in Cadmus who should
be sent to Hammer direct instead
of through Pagan signed J. H.
Taylor Chief Staff A. A. G
